smell_validity.evidence: The Handler now owns nine-plus reasons to change (authentication, path normalization, rule composition, subtree walks, upstream lock mirroring, OPTIONS and partial-update serving, per-user mounting, logging, proxy IP) while the injection deleted or stripped every former home: request.go, the rule model's decision method, the wrapper's subtree walk. The coordinator-threaded normalization callback makes the cost security-relevant, not mere bulk.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Every pipeline concern edits one 676-line type, and two couplings must be remembered: normalization reaches the listing wrapper only via a coordinator-threaded callback, and permission decisions are re-composed beside the rule model instead of asked of it. Repair restores several ownership boundaries and removes a stale-agreement hazard, though all within one library package, not architecture scale.

development_plausibility.evidence: Bodies moved verbatim with stages reading coordinator fields, rationalizing doc comments, a construction-order fix for the logger closure, and a coherent feature-drift story all fit project habits. But the sweep is total and uniform: every helper renamed in one consistent owner style and request.go deleted wholesale, a shaped reshaping faintly distinguishable from patchy piecemeal evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt resolves near-misses explicitly — keeping the callback, keeping call-site rule duplication, leaving stages on the orchestrator or per-user record — and shuts off wrong direction, incomplete cleanup, and out-of-scope redesign via the area list, preservation checklist, exported-surface constraint, and per-area definition of done, while still allowing any sound decomposition.

semantic_diversity.evidence: At least five distinct purposes must be re-homed — credential admission, parsing with trailing-slash collection semantics, authorization composition with destination-first ordering, stateful lock admission and release, per-user construction ordering, and by-construction name agreement — each requiring a different code-supported decision (predicate threading, defer/release timing, creation order, callback removal).

localization_burden.evidence: Scope is prompt-listed, but locations require tracing constructor-time registration (per-user file-system and lock selection, logger closure), a constructor-registered normalization callback dispatched inside listing OpenFile, and the prefix reached through two aliases across components. Plausible-looking exclusions exist: the pure policy helpers and orchestration branches that must stay.

repair_coordination.evidence: Shared rules must move together: normalization agreement between pipeline and listing layer, one decision point on the rule model, and the per-user lock-system instance that both dispatched PUTs and the partial-update stage must reference. A partial repair that works per-stage can still fail across stages when existing lock state interacts and the wrong namespace is consulted.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: No existing helper remains to reconnect: request parsing, the rule-model decision, and the subtree walk all live only on the coordinator. The best uniform rule — relocating methods that already receive the user record — covers roughly a third of locations; rule-model restoration, callback-free normalization, and prefix re-threading each need separate per-destination decisions.

behavioral_risk.evidence: The enumerated suite means ordinary wrong results are directly comparable and caught. But a specific wrong rehoming — wiring the moved partial-update stage to its own lock-system instance, or mis-sequencing release and spool cleanup — passes ordinary lockless calls and fails only under existing lock or error state. No test records here establish unchecked paths, capping the score.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
